description: This lexer assigns values to calculator tokens and returns operator characters to Bison.

steps.description: The C block includes the generated Bison header. The options enable line numbers and stop Flex from opening another file at end of input.
Whitespace is skipped. Newlines, integers, floats, and identifiers receive their stated token actions.
Each operator and parenthesis returns its character token.
The final rule reports an unexpected character with its line number. The last %% ends the rules section.

title: Tokenize calculator input
